mentions.name: Agentic social media marketing workflow
mentions.description: An agentic process that automates social media marketing for apps: it runs a workflow to generate high-quality blog posts relevant to the product domain, crafts X posts and replies to comments in the user's own tone, and conducts one-on-one outreach on the user's behalf.
mentions.problem: The biggest obstacle in gaining traction for the author's apps is marketing.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am currently building an agentic process to help me with social media marketing for my apps, as this is my biggest obstacle in terms of gaining traction.

evidence.value: I am currently building an agentic process to help me with social media marketing for my apps, as this is my biggest obstacle in terms of gaining traction.
